reviews.text:
Spectacular service and results!
And these dogs were covered in filth after the holidays, but they came out looking fantastic. It's a real shame I don't live in Madrid, but this will definitely become our go-to dog groomer when we return.
Great service and my little guy looked super cute.
Great grooming salon for bathing and cutting your dog's hair. The groomers are super friendly and attentive. Highly recommended!
It was a fantastic dog grooming salon, the service was great, the attention was spectacular, and my dog ​​looked great and was very happy, thank you so much

Personalized and top-notch service from day one. Happy Doggies is our go-to groomer, and we couldn't be happier. Our dog is a bit nervous, and they always make sure he has a great experience, whether it's a full bath and grooming or a quick haircut (plus, they make him look absolutely gorgeous!). Definitely 100% recommended!

I was there today with my Yorkshire Terrier for the first time. She has very sensitive eye discharge and always gets hurt, sometimes even bleeding. But at this place, they were so gentle that there's not a trace of any sore. I left very happy and we'll definitely be back.
They always make Chloe look beautiful, and the girl is super nice.
Excellent service, very friendly and fast. I took my cat for a haircut and it looks perfect. I'll definitely be back. Thank you!
They always treat my dog ​​wonderfully and make him look gorgeous.

I've been taking my Pomeranian to Happy Doggies for a while now, and they always leave her with incredibly soft, beautifully groomed fur, and no loose hair. They do a fantastic job. The owner and groomer are both very friendly. I really enjoyed it!
Very professional and unbeatable value for money.
My dog ​​is very timid, and the experience couldn't have been better. We managed to give her a bath, a haircut, and a nail trim! We'll be back soon. Thank you!

Great! I took my Spanish Water Dog, who hadn't been to the groomer in ages, and I'm really happy with the result. The service was excellent, and I'm grateful for the advice they gave me on how to keep her coat looking good.
They made my dogs look beautiful, they're so nice. I'll be back!
Thank you for your trust… We hope to see you soon!
I always come here and Gaby takes care of me. She makes me feel like a princess, we wouldn't trade this salon for anything!!! 100% recommended
Incredible service, attention, and professionalism. I truly have no words to describe Miriam and Gabi; I can only say that they treat your furry friend as if they were their own ♥️
I left my dog ​​Curro in their hands for the first time and I'm so happy. They did a perfect job. I'll definitely be back! 😁 …
Can anyone confirm how the service is since the change of ownership? Alfonso was there before, but I don't know when the new hairdressers started.

Very poor service and customer service. They quoted me one price and then charged me another. Furthermore, they left him in terrible condition and made him wait a long time at a half-finished table while they washed someone else's hair. Honestly, terrible service and customer care.

100% recommended.
They treat the dogs with such care and professionalism. My dogs go here, go in happy, and come out looking gorgeous. Thank you, guys!

Good afternoon! Today I went for the first time with my dog ​​and it was wonderful. The service was excellent, and my Umi, who's a Spanish Water Dog (it's rare for her to let them groom her), and Alfonso did a fantastic job. He made her look beautiful and lovely. I'll definitely be back. They're super friendly. I've already found a groomer for her. Overall, I felt very comfortable. Best regards.

I don't know who would think of leaving their dogs at this groomer's. I just went by and the girl was treating the poor dog badly, brushing him very roughly. The dog was crying. They should pay more attention to their dogs. I'm always very careful with mine; I don't leave him with anyone, not even my family. That's just not right. If you don't like this job, then don't do it, period. I don't recommend it.
The best dog groomer in the world. Two years ago we brought our dog in and they made him more handsome than ever before. And now we're back and once again he looks better than ever!
Perfect service, very friendly. My dog ​​looked spotless, thank you so much!

Besides being incredibly friendly, the service is unbeatable. We take our mixed-breed Spanish Water Dog there, and they always give him a perfect haircut, cutting it just right so he doesn't get sunburned since he's so fair-skinned. We'll be back a thousand times. Thank you for everything.
Very friendly and professional. My dog ​​had her first professional bath this month; I chose them and we're very happy. We'll definitely be back.
Everything was great. Fast, efficient, friendly, and most importantly, my dog ​​was happy.
They couldn't be more loving with the dogs. It's a joy, and they do a fantastic job. Trufa goes in delighted and comes out delighted!
The attention and service were fantastic. They made the pet look beautiful.
Excellent work, I highly recommend Gabi and her partner. They made my Tom look beautiful.

A perfect place to take our pets thanks to their professionalism and friendliness.
Highly recommended.
Excellent service at a reasonable price and a superb result. 100% recommended and I will definitely be back.
Our two Westies had their first hair stripping appointments and we were delighted with the service and the work, as our Westies have sensitive skin. We've found our go-to groomer! 😊 …
I took my dog ​​Frida to Happy Doggies for a haircut after other less-than-satisfied experiences, and I was delighted with the service and the way she was treated. Thank you for your professionalism.
I took my dog ​​there, and the service was incredible; they were very careful with him. I highly recommend it.

I like the service. With love and patience, my little dog Amane, who is shy, is treated with such care that she looks beautiful. Thank you for your attention; I will continue to use your services. You are very good professionals.
Annie is happier than ever at Happy Dog 😘😘😘 …
Fantastic and super affectionate

I'm very happy with the haircut my dog ​​got; it's exactly what I wanted after they asked me and made sure it was the cut I wanted. Excellent service, great attention, and very good overall experience. I'm very pleased with them and will definitely be back.
We are so happy with Sonia and Alfonso, they are wonderful! They make my little ones look spectacular. I highly recommend them. Thank you so much! 🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼❤️❤️❤️✨✨✨ …

A wonderful place! They treat the dogs with so much love, they look after them, care for them, and make them look beautiful. I assure you it's the best place you can take your pet. They also have excellent products like shampoos, washing machines, drying booths, etc.
Very happy, last week they took Rocky and he came back even more handsome than usual 🤗 …
Excellent service! I took my 1.5-year-old schnauzer there and I loved the results 🥹 The location is amazing too ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ …

I took my cat there, and Alfonso trimmed her nails and gave her a bath. She's usually quite skittish, but they treated her so well she was almost unrecognizable. I'll definitely use their services again.
Excellent! We've been here twice now and we're very happy :)

Five-star service! I took my Yorkies and they came out looking absolutely adorable. The cuts are precise and stylish, and you can tell they treat each pet with so much love. Highly recommended for pampering your furry friends!
I loved how they treated my dog! They even listened to my instructions and treated him like royalty! Thank you so much for everything!

I went to Happy Doggies on a friend's recommendation and they didn't disappoint. They gave my Shih Tzu a perfect haircut for a great price and even sent me a cute video. Thanks, ladies! I'll definitely be back.
I took my dog ​​for a bath and grooming, she looked great! They were super careful, professional, and friendly. 100% recommended.
Good. My dog ​​left happy. It's the second time I've been there and they didn't save my contact information or notify me when he's ready, but it's not a big deal. I hope they do next time.
Excellent service, my dog was handsome and clean.  Will be back
I highly recommend it! My dog ​​looks gorgeous and was so happy when she left!
Friendly attention and very good service

Without a doubt, this is a highly recommended pet groomer. You can leave your pet there with complete confidence, and the service is unbeatable.
Congratulations on your work.

Fernando
It was recommended to us and Coco left looking super handsome and very happy. We'll be back!
Great service made our dog very cute and happy ❤️
This was the first time we took her there, and they left her hair shiny and smelling amazing! They even sent us a video of her when they were finished, which was such a thoughtful touch. THANK YOU

Wonderful customer service.
The dogs looked great.

Fantastic dog grooming salon.
Very attentive and professional.
I'll definitely be back.
Thank you for the great work.
Spectacular service and great treatment
I'm so happy I found this place! Besides the amazing-smelling full bathroom, they're super fast and the prices are great! I highly recommend it!

I absolutely loved this dog groomer for my dog. They always make her look beautiful, the service is fantastic, the best of the best! I'm so happy with Happy Doggies and I recommend it to everyone with furry friends. They all leave super happy.
Thank you so much for making our dog look so handsome and for treating him so well. We'll definitely be back. We loved the video 💕 …

Highly recommended dog groomer.
They are very friendly and have a great touch with animals. Communication is quick and efficient, they don't skimp on time, and the price is very reasonable for the service they provide.
A wonderful place to take your kitten or puppy. I have a Persian cat and he does a fantastic job grooming her. The man is lovely and the prices are great! I always go to the same place.
Very professional, my baby dog ​​looked absolutely beautiful, I loved it. 😍 …
Alfonso and Gabi are lovely and super professional!!!! Lúa always leaves delighted and looking fabulous!!! 😁 …
Very nice! And good!

Super friendly and personal service thanks to Alfonso. My Pomeranian looked impeccable with a super clean cut; you do have to be patient with a Pomeranian's coat. I picked her up very happy, and we'll definitely be back. Thank you so much!! 🥰✨🐶💕 …
Excellent professionals. Dylan looks beautiful. Thank you so much for your kindness and professionalism. We will definitely be back.

I took our dog Nala to Happy Doggies for a haircut, and the owners, Alfonso and Sonia, are absolutely lovely. You can tell they love animals. They gave me a quick appointment, did a fantastic job, and offered a very competitive price. They even gave me some treats and a music video of Nala as a memento of her new look. Thank you so much, guys! You have a new customer!

Yesterday I took Obi to Happy Doggies for the first time and I'm thrilled with how they did her and how well they treated her.
I've definitely found my go-to groomer for my little one.
Thank you so much!!
First time for our dog, they treated us wonderfully. We'll be back!
A great place to bathe my dog ​​😻 …
They left the dog very clean and he came home very happy. Thank you so much!
Very good, as always!
